title: Ruleset hardening: promote three mechanical rules to Error
summary: The BCApps base ruleset now treats AL0606, AA0161 and AA0448 as errors instead of warnings. Code across apps and layers was updated to remove deprecated with statements, narrowly scope intentional AssertError uses, and show localized captions instead of technical field and table names in messages.
key_points: AL0606: 17 deprecated with statements removed and record members qualified explicitly
AA0161: 29 intentional AssertError uses in test libraries kept under narrow, documented pragma scopes
AA0448: 50 FieldName/TableName expressions in displayed messages replaced with captions
Ruleset entries drop from 72 to 69; AL0424 stays a warning
New violations in the repository now fail compilation
